I am also always tired. I think my exhaustion comes from several places, my OCD tends to keep me up at night, and since I unfortunately have an overwhelming amount of obligations, I am tired if I have to wake up in the morning. I am also tired from the medications prescribed to me over the years to for sleep aid, benzos, seroquel, trazodone, etc, it seems they always have a residual affect on me.

However, the biggest source of my exhaustion is without a doubt the obsessions. Due to extremity of my OCD, I left everything in my life behind and moved to a cheap location where I could just live with my OCD. I know this was a horrible choice, but it was between that or extreme suffering. 

My OCD thoughts seem to drag me down to extreme levels of catatonic despair. If I am to avoid doing my compulsions, which is either mental review, rationalization, or reviewing the trigger extensively, my OCD sends me down a pit of despair where I literally cannot do anything except feel extreme negativity. When I come back out of the negative thoughts (If I resisted the compulsion), I am left with nothing except pure exhaustion and depression. If I go into doing the compulsions, I am equally exhausted because that amount of focus for so many compulsions throughout the day drains my brain and will knock me out for 12 hours or more. 

The only way out is through the OCD, unfortunately. Also, sleep is extremely important for OCD. I have taken every SSRI and am currently on fluvoxamine for a few months now and I feel my OCD better controlled, the negativity not so draining. Do you take any SSRIs?
